Game Overview

At its heart, Mafia Billiard Tricks is a sports game about defy the mafia in an intense billiards showdown. Each game pushes your skills against more cunning opponents, culminating in a nail-biting match against the mob boss. Can your precision and strategy earn you the respect of these notorious figures? Prove your mettle in this engaging and stylish challenge.
